review.notes: Legacy authored course content normalized for the shared Grammar Gravity renderer; qualified language review remains required. Editorial review 2026-09-19: added short everyday nominative agreement phrases across all three genders; complexity now reflects each complete exercise, including unfamiliar nouns, plural and animacy contrasts, and case-bearing context. Existing extended examples are retained at later complexity. English glosses distinguish flowing water and a water-source spring. This machine-assisted review does not replace the required qualified native review. Capacity expansion 2026-09-19: individually authored additional phrases and sentences across every retained family and form. Beginner additions pair everyday noun phrases with short present-tense statements and questions; later examples add prepositional context, past tense, relatives, and other explicitly graded demands. Existing reviewed examples are unchanged; qualified native review remains required.
